purpose: Look for independent measured channels, repeated receiver calibration and paired concentration truth for the receiver extension.

records.title: Sub-THz VNA-based Channel Sounder Structure and Channel Measurements at 100 and 300 GHz
records.observed_metadata: Search indexed two frequency response MAT files and a readme. The direct record request returned HTTP 429.
records.decision: Candidate propagation data only; raw files not acquired or inspected. Do not infer independent gas truth or calibration repeatability from the title.

records.title: Sub-THz Channel Sounding Dataset
records.observed_metadata: Primary laboratory page describes 154/300 GHz directional channel transfer measurements, 4/8 GHz bandwidth and back-to-back calibration. Download requires registration. The displayed schema describes propagation scenarios rather than paired pollutant truth or repeated residual calibration campaigns.
records.decision: Useful future propagation stress source. Not acquired; no registration or communication submitted. The described calibration procedure does not establish the 0.0001 dB residual required here.

records.title: Ultrafast 10 ppb Acetonitrile THz Gas Sensor Based on Flexible Low-Loss Ag/PP Hollow Waveguide
records.observed_metadata: Search identified the article title; the publisher request returned HTTP 403.
records.decision: Unreviewed lead. No quantitative performance or measurement data from this paper are used in the new evaluation.

result: No suitable independent calibration and paired concentration dataset was acquired in this additional bounded search. This is not a claim that none exists.
